name: Louis Stern Fine Arts
about_text: Louis Stern Fine Arts is a gallery in West Hollywood's Design District focused on Mid-Century West Coast Geometric Abstraction, representing the artists who defined California Hard Edge painting, including Lorser Feitelson, Helen Lundeberg and Karl Benjamin, alongside other Mid-Century abstractionists such as John McLaughlin, Frederick Hammersley and Roger Kuntz. The gallery also manages several artist estates, among them Mark Feldstein, Ynez Johnston, Matsumi Kanemitsu, Alfredo Ramos Martínez, Mimi Chen Ting, Doug Ohlson and Frederick Wight. Its contemporary roster includes painters, sculptors and photographers who extend this historic program. Beyond exhibitions, the gallery is active in the secondary market, with particular strength in Impressionist, Post-Impressionist, Modern and Latin American art, and oversees the catalogue raisonné project for Alfredo Ramos Martínez.

Some artists appear on the general Artists index but not in either the 'Estates' or 'Artists Represented' subcategories; these were coded as 'exhibited' based on the 'Works Available' listing rather than an explicit representation claim.

triage.site_notes: The site organizes content under /artists (roster index plus per-artist sub-pages for bio/CV/exhibitions), /exhibitions (a full current+past archive at /exhibitions/past covering all shows including art fairs), and /news (paginated by year via /news/c/YEAR). Publications are a separate catalog-style section not covered by the requested labels; no distinct 'about' page was found in the inventory.
